prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop", "How to Interact with Your Pet", "Drag your pet anywhere on screen, double-click to chat, or right-click to access quick tray settings.", "Right-click pet for menu controls & hide option"]
1: ["Official Desktop Companion Certificate", "Give your new desktop companion a name to finalize your official adoption record.", "Official Adoption Seal"]
2: ["Save Your Adoption Record", "Sign in to save your newly created pet to your account and prevent progress loss."]
3: ["Preview Desktop Pet Life", "Watch how companions roam your screen, react to open apps, and rest alongside your work."]
4: ["Sign In to Restore Existing Pets", "Already adopted a pet? Sign into your account to immediately restore your desktop companion and save current progress.", "Your account keeps your companions safely synced across sessions."]
5: ["Building Your Desktop Pet", "Rendering custom animations and configuring desktop interactions..."]
6: ["Choose Your Companion Persona", "Select a pet visual style on the left and review personality traits on the right."]
7: ["For best results, upload a clear front-facing photo with good lighting and contrast.", "Supported formats: PNG, JPG under 10MB"]
8: ["You can safely minimize this window. We will send a desktop alert as soon as your pet is ready!"]
9: ["Pick a Path & Claim Free Desktop Toy", "Choose your pet path today to unlock an exclusive starter toy accessory for your desktop companion.", "Free Starter Accessory Included"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and creates urgency
